mapper.select: SELECT fp.FINPROD_ID finprodId, fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, to_date(#{mdate},'yyyy-MM-dd') as mdate, PDI.PRD_DESIGN_ID prdDesignId, PDI.PRD_DESIGN_SERIAL_NAME prdDesignSerialName, PDI.PRD_BASE_GOAL prdBaseGoal, PDI.PRD_CHARATER prdCharater, PDI.RAISE_TYPE raiseType, PDI.INVEST_NATURE investNature, PDI.OPERATE_MODE operateMode, PDI.TAR_CUSTOMER_TYPE tarCustomerType, PDI.TAR_INVESTOR tarInvestor, PDI.RSK_LEVEL rskLevel, PDI.OPEN_DESCRIBE openDescribe, PDI.PRD_TERM prdTerm, PDI.PLAN_ISSUE_DATE planIssueDate, PDI.PLAN_ISSUE_SCALE planIssueScale, PDI.SALE_AREA saleArea, PDI.BASE_RULE_INFO baseRuleInfo, PDI.FEE_RATE feeRate, PDI.TOFF_START toffStart, PDI.HUGE_RED_RATIO hugeRedRatio, PDI.INV_ASSET_RATE invAssetRate, PDI.INTEN_INV_STRATEGY intenInvStrategy FROM PRODUCT_DESIGN_INFO pdi INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa ON fpa.PRD_DESIGN_ID = pdi.PRD_DESIGN_ID AND pdi.DATA_STATUS = #{dataStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND fpa.FINPROD_ID = #{proId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = fpa.FINPROD_ID

SELECT FP.FINPROD_NAME finprodName,/*--产品名称*/ FP.FINPROD_ID finprodId,/*--产品代码*/ BPP.CDATE cdate,/*--估值日期*/ BPP.TDY_UNIT_VALUE tdyUnitValue,/*--当日单位净值*/ BPP.TDY_UNIT_VALUE_SUM tdyUnitValueSum,/*--当日累计净值*/ (BPP.YIELD_7 * 100) AS yield7,/*--七日年化收益率%*/ BPP.TDY_SHARE_AMT tdyShareAmt/*--当日份额*/ FROM BOK_POSITION_PRD bpp INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON BPP.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE BPP.FINPROD_ID = #{proId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND to_char(BPP.CDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') >= #{vdate} AND to_char(BPP.CDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') <= #{mdate}

select fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, fp.FINPROD_ID finprodId, fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, fp.PROFIT_TYPE profitType, fp.VDATE vdate, fpa.DEAL_MODE dealMode from FIN_PRODUCT fp left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa on fp.FINPROD_ID = fpa.FINPROD_ID where fp.FINPROD_ID = #{proId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT A.FINPROD_NAME finprodName , C.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId , C.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, 'root' parentInfo, CASE WHEN count(D.PORTFOLIO_ID) > 0 THEN '02' ELSE '01' END AS hasChildren FROM FIN_PRODUCT A /*标的类金融产品*/ INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD B /*标的类金融产品附属表*/ ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO C /*组合*/ ON B.PORTFOLIO_ID = C.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_VALUTION D /*组合资产估值*/ ON C.PORTFOLIO_ID = D.PORTFOLIO_ID AND TO_CHAR(D.CDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{mdate} WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{proId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY A.FINPROD_NAME, C.PORTFOLIO_ID, C.PORTFOLIO_NAME

SELECT '' portfolioId, '${parentId}' parentInfo, '01' hasChildren, NVL(X.FINPROD_ID, E.FINPROD_ID) assetCode , NVL(X.FINPROD_NAME, '') assetName , NVL(X.FINPROD_TYPE2, E.FINPROD_TYPE2) finprodType , F.TYPE_9 secondType , F.TYPE_10 thirdType , F.TYPE_11 fourthType , F.TYPE_12 fifthType, SUM(NVL(D.SHARE_AMT, 0)) shareNum , SUM(NVL(D.DSC_COST_AMT, 0) + NVL(D.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, 0)) assetNetNum FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO C inner JOIN PTL_SEC_VALUTION D /*组合资产估值*/ ON C.PORTFOLIO_ID = D.PORTFOLIO_ID AND TO_CHAR(D.CDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{mdate} LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT X ON X.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT E /*交易类金融产品*/ ON E.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID AND E.BRANCH = 0 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE F /*金融产品分类表*/ ON (F.FINPROD_ID = E.FINPROD_ID OR F.FINPROD_ID = X.FINPROD_ID) WHERE C.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{parentId} GROUP BY '', '${parentId}', '02', NVL(X.FINPROD_ID, E.FINPROD_ID) , NVL(X.FINPROD_NAME, '') , NVL(X.FINPROD_TYPE2, E.FINPROD_TYPE2) , F.TYPE_9, F.TYPE_10, F.TYPE_11, F.TYPE_12

SELECT X.FINPROD_NAME finprodName , B.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId , B.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName , SUM(NVL(C.SHARE_AMT, 0)) portfolioShare FROM FIN_PRODUCT X INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD A ON A.FINPROD_ID = X.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO B ON A.PORTFOLIO_ID = B.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID INNER JOIN PTL_SEC_VALUTION C ON B.PORTFOLIO_ID = C.PORTFOLIO_ID AND to_char(C.CDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{mdate} WHERE X.FINPROD_ID = #{proId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY X.FINPROD_NAME, B.PORTFOLIO_ID, B.PORTFOLIO_NAME

SELECT pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID parentPortfolioId,/*组合代码*/ pp.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId,/*子组合代码*/ pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName /*子组合名称*/ FROM FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON fpa.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE fpa.FINPROD_ID = #{proId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
